facts.blindfold: A woman in white sits on a stone seat with her eyes covered.
facts.crossed-arms: Her arms are crossed in front of her chest, holding two swords up over her shoulders.
facts.back-to-sea: Behind her spreads a sea, with rocks rising out of the water.
facts.crescent: A crescent moon floats in the sky at the upper right.
facts.grey-ground: The ground under her feet is gray.

glosses.blindfold: Covering what she does not want to see and putting off the decision.
glosses.crossed-arms: A posture that closes the heart and holds on only to the balance.
glosses.crescent: A moon not yet full; information not yet revealed.

reversedGloss.blocked: Too much information causes confusion, and the decision stays blocked.
reversedGloss.waning: The stalemate she held through loosens, and the time to decide arrives.
reversedGloss.excess: Holding out too long makes the pressure grow.

misdescriptions.wrong: She looks ahead with her eyes open.
She has stuck the swords into the ground.
A full moon hangs in the sky.
